## What `src/billing.ts` does

It's a 310-line billing module centred on the **`generateInvoice`** orchestrator (lines 50–253, 204 lines) plus a **`calculateRefundPreview`** function (lines 40–44) that — despite its pure-sounding name — calls `saveRefundAudit` and `sendRefundEmail`. The file deals heavily in `"enterprise"` plan logic and reads wall-clock time directly (7 `Date.now()`/`new Date()` calls scattered across lines 57–273). A comment on L39 carries a hidden access rule: *"Only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves"* — that rule isn't obviously encoded in nearby code.

## Related files to read before editing

- **`src/billing.test.ts`** — only existing tests, and both are weak (one has zero assertions, one only uses a weak matcher).
- **`src/api/plan.ts`, `src/jobs/plan-sync.ts`, `src/ui/pricing.ts`** — share the `"enterprise"` literal; any change to plan semantics in `billing.ts` likely needs to land here too.
- **`docs/billing.md`** — uses `account` as an alias of the `tenant` concept group; check terminology before introducing new names.
- **`src/date.ts`** — sibling date utility (has its own Temporal Recklessness / mixed UTC-local / DST issues); likely where a `now()` injection would live.
